datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified against the supplied expected hash.
The Fig. 1 curve labelled 5.1 was digitized from the plotted curve only; points are approximate readings at plotted grid currents and are not extrapolated.
Curve axes are shown as positive voltage and current magnitudes for reverse zener operation; the datasheet polarity marking identifies the cathode line.
MMSZ5231B table values at Ta = 25 degC: VZ minimum 4.85 V, nominal 5.10 V, maximum 5.36 V at IZT = 20 mA; maximum ZZT is 17 ohm at IZT = 0.25 mA; maximum IR is 5 microA at VR = 2.0 V.
No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is provided in the supplied datasheet.
